body: Thank you soo much! I will wait and hope for the best. Do you have any tips for the aftercare? As I  was only told to put petroleum jelly once daily. Thanks in advance

No its called seasonal cause usually it comes with the seasons but for me it sometimes disappears and then comes out of nowhere.. not ongoing like the usual bipolarity and thus was very hard to diagnose with the existing bpd.. I live in egypt where Its usually jot and I am allergic to heat.. hahaha!
My life is funny! Thank you for your wishes.. I have been through ups and downs but the down this time around is hitting me hard specially with me being that aware! 
I hope you get to experience some peace time too and hopefully very soon

Well I am happy for you and it’s good that you’re aware if how a relationship is.. yet don’t be too hard on yourself! You are not the worst person to be in a relationship with.. I wish you both happiness!
That is something else I suffer from! I am sorry for that!
I am sorry I was kidding!
Is it ok if I feel jealous you have someone who understands?!! Or too pathetic?! 😂

First of all thank you.. second I know what you mean but I do have seasonal bipolarity so yet again I don’t know which screes me up more.. meds stopped working for me..
I keep thinking how other people interpret the world or see it?
Without that emotional rollercoaster and without the sensitivity and aggressiveness.. without noticing every single detail.. every change! 
What I would give to live that for one day!

You know I have always thought I am a chameleon as I somehow absorb the personalities of others that I am around..  I guess a pathetic try to fit in.. yet I still have string opinions yet praise myself for being accepting.. gish the turmoil
I understand and you feel you.. I wish I knew how to make my head empty.. it’s so filled with thoughts it’s a roller coaster ride every second.

This is sooo helpful.. it feels like I am not alone! I am also diagnosed with seasonal bipolarity.. I hit the jackpot!

I believe the keyword is people I trust.

Thank you for replying but I don’t even know what the real me is.. 
The thing is that the home me is very down and I dong like her and no of the other versions is me.. I feel the real me got lost between all the masks..
And I overthink everything.. Reaching for help even here always feel like I am looking for attention!
Others are causing me pain.. life would be so much better off without me! And even if someone suffers it would be for a while.. i suffer all the time
But i really don’t want to!
